regions.today: Another warm day with a mix of sunshine, scattered cloud and just the odd isolated shower. Feeling very warm again with highest temperature of 24 to 28 degrees with light winds becoming southerly later.
regions.tonight: Becoming a little more cloudy later but staying mostly dry overall. Southerly breezes and lows of 14 to 17 degrees.
regions.tomorrow: Becoming overcast early on with scattered showers and southerly breezes. Cooler than previous days with highest temperatures of 19 to 23 degrees.
